decisions.reason: The XL tier of the anamnesis app is a cheap configuration of an existing product that serves growing multi-site dental groups, so keeping this option open costs almost nothing while demand from larger practices is still unfolding.

The materials management module was launched only in 2024 and its uptake is still uncertain, but it fits the firm's integrated, paperless practice strategy and costs little to maintain inside the modular suite, so the option stays open until results show its value.

The KIM secure messaging client is part of the mandatory telematics infrastructure for German dental practices and is actively updated (KIM 1.5), so it is a regulatory necessity whose value is already largely confirmed and not an option to abandon.
